BrochureContent.Content:
Aurora is an exceptionally spacious and beautifully presented detached residence extending to approximately 352 sq m, set on around 1.3 acres in the sought-after Ballymacahara area, just outside Ashford village. Combining generous proportions with a bright, contemporary finish, the property has been thoughtfully upgraded to create a home that feels both impressive and wonderfully practical.

The accommodation is arranged with modern family life firmly in mind. At its heart is the superb open-plan kitchen and dining room, recently remodelled and finished in a crisp contemporary style. A large central island, quartz worktops and excellent storage are complemented by expansive glazing and sliding doors opening directly onto the patio and gardens, creating an easy connection between indoors and out.

The principal reception room is equally generous, with multiple windows drawing in natural light and framing the surrounding countryside. Solid wood flooring and a stone fireplace with wood-burning stove bring warmth and character to the space, while a further living area offers additional flexibility for day-to-day family use.

The bedroom accommodation is particularly impressive. The main bedroom suite includes its own balcony, walk-in wardrobe and spacious en-suite, while the remaining bedrooms are all well-proportioned and served by excellent bathroom facilities.

One of Aurora's most valuable features is the self-contained one-bedroom apartment. Connected to the main residence yet also benefiting from its own private entrance, it includes a modern kitchen, living room, large double bedroom and en-suite. This creates an exceptional option for multigenerational living, an older child or relative seeking greater independence, guest accommodation or, subject to any necessary requirements, a potential source of rental income.

The flexibility continues on the lower level, where a large games room, dedicated gym area, private study and extensive storage provide space that can evolve with the needs of the household. There is also direct access to the substantial garage.

Outside, Aurora is approached through electric gates onto a sweeping driveway with ample parking. The mature grounds have been carefully landscaped and enjoy an attractive open aspect, with large lawns, planted areas, wonderful Koi filled pond and several places to sit out and take in the surrounding countryside and sea views.

Despite its peaceful setting, Ashford village is only a short distance away, putting schools, shops, cafés, sporting facilities and transport links within easy reach.

Aurora is ultimately a home defined by space and versatility — beautifully finished, exceptionally comfortable and capable of accommodating several generations under one roof without compromise.Aurora is an exceptionally spacious and beautifully presented detached residence extending to approximately 352 sq m, set on around 1.3 acres in the sought-after Ballymacahara area, just outside Ashford village. Entrance Hall - 6.20m x 2.80m
An impressive introduction to the home, with a wonderfully bright and spacious feel enhanced by the high ceiling and feature glazing above the entrance door. Solid wood flooring adds warmth, while the generous proportions immediately give a sense of the scale found throughout Aurora.

Living Room - 9.57m x 5.74m
An impressive introduction to the home, with a wonderfully bright and spacious feel enhanced by the high ceiling and feature glazing above the entrance door. Solid wood flooring with detail inset adds warmth, while the generous proportions immediately give a sense of the scale found throughout Aurora.

Kitchen / Dining Room - 8.54m x 5.79m
A beautifully remodelled contemporary kitchen and dining space designed for both everyday family life and entertaining. The kitchen offers an extensive range of fitted cabinetry together with premium appliances and a substantial central island topped with quartz worktops. The island also incorporates the sink, Quooker tap, integrated dishwasher and excellent additional storage. Expansive glazing and large sliding doors open directly onto the patio and gardens, while the adjoining dining area benefits from solid wood flooring and a wood-burning stove.

Master Bedroom - 5.38m x 4.68m
An exceptionally spacious main bedroom suite enjoying a wonderful sense of privacy and light. Solid wood flooring runs throughout, while doors open onto a private balcony taking full advantage of the surrounding views.Walk-in Wardrobe / Dressing RoomA generously sized dressing room providing excellent fitted storage and creating a practical separation between the bedroom and en-suite.

Ensuite Bathroom - 3.83m x 3.12m
A large and well-appointed en-suite bathroom serving the principal bedroom suite, finished in a modern style and offering excellent space with walk in shower, free standing tub and his and hers sinks.

Bedroom 2 - 4.51m x 3.92m
A spacious double bedroom with excellent natural light and ample room for additional bedroom furniture.

Bedroom 3 - 4.53m x 3.81m
Another generously proportioned double bedroom, well suited to family or guest accommodation.

Jack and Jill Bathroom - 1.80m x 1.70m
Conveniently positioned between Bedrooms Two and Three, providing private access from both rooms and creating an ideal arrangement for children or guests.

Bedroom 4 - 3.34m x 3.30m
A comfortable and well-proportioned double bedroom offering flexible family accommodation.

Bathroom - 2.77m x 2.50m
A bright and spacious family bathroom finished in a contemporary style with cream marble tiling throughout, walk in shower, bath, wash hand basin and wc.

Cloakroom - 
A useful additional cloakroom located off the main accommodation.

Games Room/Gym - 8.80m x 4.74m
A fantastic entertaining space with generous proportions and ample room for a full-size pool table. This versatile room is ideal for teenagers, family gatherings or relaxed entertaining and further reinforces the exceptional amount of living space on offer.

Study - 2.34m x 1.86m
A private home office tucked away from the main living areas, offering a quiet and practical workspace for anyone working remotely.

Store Room - 3.64m x 2.63m
Further practical storage space.

Garage - 7.38m x 4.13m
A substantial garage offering excellent storage and practical access from within the property.

Kitchen/Living Room - 9.66m x 4.78m
A generous and comfortable living space forming part of the self-contained apartment. With direct access from the main house as well as its own private entrance, this area offers genuine independence while remaining conveniently connected to the principal residence.The open plan living space features stylish herringbone flooring, attractive fireplace with solid fuel stove, and a fully fitted grey shaker style kitchen with contemporary tiled splashback

Bedroom 5 - 4.71m x 3.94m
A generous double bedroom enjoying garden views, built in wardrobes and a fully tiled ensuite bathroom.

Ensuite Bathroom - 3.19m x 2.18m
Fully tiled ensuite with WC and WHB.

Utility Room - 2.91m x 2.57m
Plumbed for white goods.

Gardens - 
Aurora is approached through electric gates onto a sweeping driveway with generous parking, setting the tone for the sense of privacy and space found throughout the property. The gardens extend to approximately 1.3 acres and have been thoughtfully landscaped to create a series of attractive outdoor areas that can be enjoyed throughout the day.Expansive lawns are complemented by mature planting, established trees and an attractive ornamental pond stocked with Koi, creating a peaceful focal point within the gardens. The grounds enjoy a wonderful open aspect, with views across the surrounding countryside together with sea views in the distance.A particularly impressive feature is the extensive patio area directly off the kitchen and dining room. This creates a natural extension of the main living space and provides an excellent setting for outdoor dining, entertaining and summer gatherings, with an easy flow between the house and garden.The self-contained apartment also benefits from its own smaller private patio area, giving occupants a separate outdoor space and further enhancing the independence and versatility of this accommodation.With its combination of mature gardens, generous lawns, extensive patios, Koi pond and far-reaching countryside and sea views, the outdoor space at Aurora is every bit as impressive as the accommodation itself.
